text:
opsbot: INCIDENT ALERT — streaming node 'decode-7' in eu-west-1 is flapping; repeated CUDA OOMs + container restarts. Request drops observed (~1.2k failed in last 5m). Auto-quarantine tripped.

emma (oncall): I'm on it. pulling logs now, will triage. ping me for handoff.

raj: seeing a burst of requests with max_tokens=100000 in headers. sample:
```
POST /v1/stream
x-max-tokens: 100000
...
```

sylvia: KV cache growth on that node up to 48GB, never seen that before. likely runaway generation + large token window.

luca: rolling a quick router rule to cap x-max-tokens to 4096 for inbound on eu-west-1. deploying patch.

deploy-bot: hotpatch applied to router-eu-west-1-3 — rule: cap x-max-tokens=4096

emma (oncall): thanks @luca. start rate-limiting suspicious clients too (user agent pattern 'gen-client/'). which apps impacted?

cust-ops: we have an open support ticket for AcmeCorp; they've reported 502s since 10:45. I'll coordinate patch note.

jordan: starting a targeted eviction of decode-7 and draining traffic to decode-9. will monitor memory delta.

raj: confirm logs show repeated "cudaErrorMemoryAllocation" followed by container restart. stack snippet:
```
E CUDA: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
E Decoder: failed at kv_cache_grow()
```

sylvia: telemetry shows ~12 customers with >90% errors, top offender has 60% of error volume (probable token storm).

luca: applied conservative batching limits and disabled large-prefix caching on decode-9 for now.

emma (oncall): handing off to @raj for next 30m — I'm jumping to customer comms and incident doc. @cust-ops please escalate CSAT for AcmeCorp.

raj: taking over. continuing drain + watching for recurrence. will reopen if we see OOM after cap.

deploy-bot: autoscaler triggered extra decode nodes (decode-10, decode-11) due to drain.

emma (oncall): quick postmortem action items: 1) router hard cap for x-max-tokens across regions 2) detect runaway token headers and auto-quarantine 3) add KV cache high-water alert. I'll file follow-ups.

sylvia: adding eval to reject x-max-tokens>8192 at edge and send 429 instead of letting it reach decode nodes.

raj: noted. monitoring stable for 8m, memory under control, dropping error rate. closing active pagers but will keep channel open for updates.

opsbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — decode-7 stabilized after routing/drain. Incident closed at 1718974900.
